APIs.classification_masks: item['detection'] before any materialize_projection or diagnostic export
APIs.compatibility: compare_depth continues to return original complete points/digest; saved replay API unchanged
APIs.optional_export: replay_saved.export_depth_diagnostics; not required before 2D mask publication

mask_contract.shape: (H,W) from original captured frame intrinsics; current original camera480x848
mask_contract.indexing: mask[v,u] = original image row v, column u; same orientation, no transpose/flip/resample/crop or pixel-index offset

fields.candidate_mask: Original optical-Z foreground candidate; green policy requested by user. No confirmed-object/cluster/3D/risk meaning.
fields.uncertain_candidate_mask: Original unresolved valid-depth pixels; orange policy. Includes unsupported/unknown/edges/occlusions/unqualified pixels as actually classified.
fields.reason_masks.matched_static: Original known STATIC matches; retain base image appearance.
fields.reason_masks.matched_self: Original known SELF matches only when actually classified; no unknown SELF promotion.
fields.reason_masks.matched_held: Original known HELD matches; retain base image appearance.
fields.reason_masks.invalid_actual: Original invalid/out-of-range/unseen actual depth; no green/orange promotion.

mask_contract.primary_partition: candidate, uncertain, union of three matched masks, invalid form a disjoint complete pixel partition. Three matched masks are mutually exclusive by original owner.
mask_contract.overlap: Reject inconsistent primary overlaps; do not resolve by recoloring/reclassifying. Auxiliary reason masks may overlap and are explanatory, not extra obstacle labels.
mask_contract.readonly: Do not modify original arrays or flags. Example snapshots byte-identical C-order bool masks into bytes-backed nonwritable NumPy buffers. UI owns these copies, cannot set writable=true; detector arrays remain unchanged.
mask_contract.lifetime: Keep source identity and owned RGB/depth/mask buffers together through queue/drop handling. No reuse of mutable borrowed producer buffers.
mask_contract.pixel_convention: Preserve original frame convention and separate effective qualified convention. A [.5,.5] effective ray offset does not shift/resize display mask indices.
RGB_join: Exact same-writer receipt pins both RGB and depth refs.
Match session_id, canonical frame clock_epoch and frame_seq, original reference_time, renderer_frame_id, render request/source proof, camera path and captured source_stamp_s.
renderer_frame_id alone may repeat; use full identity and source SHA. No nearest/latest RGB or wall-clock matching.
Validate source_frame_ref against expected.frame_state and original depth C-byte hash. Pin-check receipt/RGB/depth refs; H/W must equal original frame.
If matching RGB unavailable, omit RGB overlay or use same-frame depth base; never pair another frame.
mask_contract.guard: Guarded/stale/unassociated detection is not an empty safe overlay. Preserve original status/source time; no source timestamp rewrite. Display historical data only with its actual source identity/age.
mask_contract.colors_and_screen_owner: MI owns actual colors/alpha/drawing/UI; Depth provides original masks only. No Depth UI code added.
mask_contract.source_values_unchanged: Original RGB, depth, recorded metadata, detector arrays and projected point output remain unchanged.

frame_counts_not_interchangeable: Native09 positive00100=17592; native10 first-positive00100=5710 belongs to another capture/session and is not substituted.

native11_dependency.rule: Review fresh actual pre-obstacle session/camera/model/source refs and construct fresh scope; no old session copy or posthoc retag.
native11_dependency.consumer: Pin-check new qualification_report.error_ref and read that model for this session. Do not reuse native09/native10 model refs for native11.
